summary: Added a local npm audit summarizer so raw npm-audit.json output can be converted into an actionable package/severity/fix summary before dependency updates are applied.
findings: Vercel reports 2 npm audit findings, but the summary log does not include the affected package names.
The repository had commands to generate raw audit JSON, but no repo-local parser to summarize the result consistently.
actions_taken: Updated the npm audit triage documentation to run the JSON + summary pair before dependency changes.
Kept npm audit out of security:ci until the advisory package names and dependency diff are reviewed.
next_cycle_focus: Verify Vercel status for the documentation/tooling-only commits.
Run npm run security:npm-audit:json > npm-audit.json followed by npm run security:npm-audit:summary in a connected environment.
Apply targeted dependency updates only after the summary identifies affected package chains.
